{{Infobox tree |title1=Scorched Tree |image1=Scorched Trees.webp |biome=[[Ashlands]] |wood_type=[[Ashwood]] and [[Wood]] |yield=20 |tool_needed=[[Stone Axe]] |additional_loot=[[Charcoal Resin]] }} '''Scorched Tree''' is a type of [[trees|tree]] encountered in the [[Ashlands]] biome. They are black, tall, and menacing, with crooked branches and a looming figure. Scorched Trees are a source of [[Ashwood]], the Ashlands-tier wood. In addition, small amounts of [[Wood]] and [[Charcoal Resin]] can be obtained from them. Getting struck by a Scorched Tree log inflicts [[Burning]]. ==Drop== {| class="wikitable" |+Tree: 50% chance for 2 drops !Item !Amount !Chance !Average |- | [[Ashwood]] (66.7%) or
[[Wood]] (33.3%) |20 |From logs | 13.3 Ashwood
6.6 Wood |- |[[Ashwood]] |2 |From stump |2 |- |[[Ashwood]] | 1-4 | 33% from tree fall | 0.75 |- |[[Charcoal Resin]] | 1-2 | 17% | 0.25 |} == Planting == Scorched Trees cannot be planted, nor do they regrow naturally. Thus, Ashwood and Charcoal resin are limited resources. However, despite the overall size of the biome, scorched trees are highly plentiful throughout the landscape, making ashwood a very easily obtainable resource, and as of the Ashlands update, charcoal resin has no uses outside of building green pots. == '''Trivia''' == Scorched Trees are so far, the only trees that have multiple different looking tree models.{{WorldNav}} [[ru:Горелое дерево]] [[Category:Trees]]
